items.title: Validation and prognostic value of the five-repetition sit-to-stand test in patients with severe exacerbation of COPD.
items.summary: In patients with severe COPD exacerbation, the five-repetition sit-to-stand (5STS) test correlated negatively with quadriceps force (r = -0.487) and 6-minute walk test (r = -0.415). A cut-off of ≥13 seconds predicted higher readmission risk within six months with an AUC of 0.720 (95% CI: 0.588-0.853).
items.curatedReason: 5 次坐站测试（5STS）能用于评估慢阻肺急性加重住院患者的肌力和运动耐量，并对 6 个月内再入院风险有可接受的预测价值。这项测试对临床决策有补充信息。
items.titleZh: 5 次坐站测试在慢阻肺急性加重患者中的验证和预后价值
items.summaryZh: 这项前瞻性观察研究纳入 58 例慢阻肺急性加重住院患者，发现 5 次坐站测试（5STS）与股四头肌力量 (r = -0.487) 和 6 分钟步行测试 (r = -0.415) 呈显著负相关。5STS 评分 ≥13 秒可预测患者 6 个月内再入院风险更高（AUC 0.720）。
items.curatedReasonEn: The five-repetition sit-to-stand (5STS) test can assess muscle strength and exercise tolerance in hospitalized patients with severe COPD exacerbation and offers acceptable prognostic value for 6-month readmission risk. This provides supplementary information for clinical decision-making.
items.limitation: 研究样本量较小，且为单中心观察性研究，结果外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: The study has a small sample size and is a single-center observational study, limiting the generalizability of the findings.

items.title: Efficacy and safety of mitapivat in patients with sickle cell disease (RISE UP): a phase 3, double-blind, global, randomised, placebo-controlled trial
items.summary: The phase 3 RISE UP trial indicates mitapivat, an oral pyruvate kinase activator, shows potential as an effective and convenient disease-modifying treatment for sickle cell disease by ameliorating hemolytic anemia.
items.curatedReason: RISE UP 试验的三期数据表明，口服丙酮酸激酶激活剂 mitapivat 可能是一种有效的、便捷的镰状细胞病疾病改良治疗方法，能够改善溶血性贫血。对于 PT 而言，虽然直接干预有限，但了解此类新型系统性疗法对患者整体健康状况的影响，有助于更好地规划跨学科协作与患者教育。
items.titleZh: mitapivat 在镰状细胞病患者中的疗效与安全性（RISE UP）：一项 III 期、双盲、全球性、随机、安慰剂对照试验
items.summaryZh: RISE UP 试验表明，口服丙酮酸激酶激活剂 mitapivat 是一种有潜力有效且便捷的镰状细胞病疾病改良治疗方法，能改善溶血性贫血。
items.curatedReasonEn: Phase 3 data from the RISE UP trial suggest mitapivat, an oral pyruvate kinase activator, may be an effective and convenient disease-modifying treatment for sickle cell disease, ameliorating hemolytic anemia. For PTs, understanding such novel systemic therapies can inform interdisciplinary collaboration and patient education, even with limited direct intervention.
items.limitation: 该研究仅报告了干预的潜在益处，但未提供具体的临床疗效数据或 PT 相关的结局指标。
items.limitationEn: This entry only reports the potential benefits of the intervention and does not provide specific clinical efficacy data or PT-relevant outcomes.

items.title: [Correspondence] Beyond imaging thresholds in large-core stroke thrombectomy
items.summary: An individual patient data meta-analysis suggests endovascular thrombectomy (EVT) in large-core ischemic stroke up to 24h improves functional outcomes and reduces mortality, challenging the futility paradigm.
items.curatedReason: 这项荟萃分析挑战了“大面积梗死对再灌注治疗无效”的传统观念，显示了在发病 24 小时内的大核心卒中患者中，血管内取栓（EVT）可改善功能结局并降低死亡率。这对于 PT 来说，意味着有更多患者可能从早期神经康复中获益，需要 PT 团队与神经介入团队更紧密的协作。
items.titleZh: 大核心卒中取栓的影像学阈值之外
items.summaryZh: 一项个体患者数据荟萃分析显示，在发病 24 小时内的大核心缺血性卒中患者中，血管内取栓（EVT）可改善功能结局并降低死亡率，这挑战了传统观念。
items.curatedReasonEn: This meta-analysis challenges the paradigm that large infarction is futile for reperfusion therapy, demonstrating that endovascular thrombectomy (EVT) improves functional outcomes and reduces mortality in patients with large-core ischemic stroke up to 24 hours after onset, suggesting a wider scope for early neurorehabilitation.
items.limitation: 该研究基于个体患者数据荟萃分析，数据截止至 2026 年，可能未能完全涵盖最新技术或长期随访数据。
items.limitationEn: The study is an individual patient data meta-analysis and, as of 2026, may not fully encompass the latest techniques or long-term follow-up data.

items.title: Hybrid versus in-clinic rehabilitation for non-traumatic shoulder pain within a standardized digital care pathway: a prospective longitudinal observational study
items.summary: A prospective longitudinal observational study of 164 rehabilitation episodes for non-traumatic shoulder pain found no clear between-modality difference in time to documented clinical discharge or secondary outcomes between hybrid (1 in-clinic, 2 home sessions/week) and in-clinic (3 in-clinic sessions/week) rehabilitation.
items.curatedReason: 这项观察性研究提示，对于非创伤性肩痛患者，混合康复（每周一次诊所，两次居家）与纯诊所康复（每周三次诊所）在达到临床出院时间和功能结果上差异不大。这支持了远程康复在某些情况下能提供与面对面康复类似的效果，为你的服务模式提供了参考。
items.titleZh: 标准化数字护理路径中混合式康复与诊所内康复治疗非创伤性肩痛的对比：一项前瞻性纵向观察性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项针对非创伤性肩痛的纵向观察性研究（164 例）发现，混合式康复（每周 1 次诊所，2 次居家）与纯诊所内康复（每周 3 次诊所）在达到临床出院时间和次要结局方面没有明显差异。
items.curatedReasonEn: This observational study suggests that for non-traumatic shoulder pain, hybrid rehabilitation (one in-clinic, two home sessions weekly) shows no clear difference in time to clinical discharge and functional outcomes compared to in-clinic rehabilitation (three in-clinic sessions weekly). This supports remote rehab as a comparable option to in-person care in certain situations, informing your service delivery models.
items.limitation: 本研究为非随机分配的观察性研究，存在残余混杂和潜在的信息性删失，无法确立等效性、非劣效性或因果比较效果。
items.limitationEn: This was a non-randomized observational study, susceptible to residual confounding and potentially informative censoring, precluding conclusions on equivalence, non-inferiority, or causal comparative effectiveness.

items.title: Elastic band resistance training improves physical function, gait, cardiac indices, and corticomuscular coherence in older women at risk of sarcopenia: a randomized controlled trial
items.summary: In 40 older women at risk of sarcopenia, 12 weeks of elastic band resistance training significantly improved muscle strength, physical function, gait parameters (increased stride length, reduced double-support time), and corticomuscular coherence, alongside positive changes in cardiac morphology and function.
items.curatedReason: 对社区中存在肌少症风险的老年女性，弹力带抗阻训练 12 周能显著提升肌肉力量、改善步态，甚至对心脏形态和功能也有积极影响。这些数据充分支持我们将弹力带作为一种安全、经济有效的居家训练手段，推广给我们的肌少症高风险患者。
items.titleZh: 弹力带抗阻训练改善存在肌少症风险的老年女性的身体功能、步态、心脏指标和皮质肌肉相干性：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 对 40 名有肌少症风险的老年女性进行为期 12 周的弹力带抗阻训练，显著改善了肌肉力量、身体功能、步态参数（增加步幅、减少双支撑时间）和皮质肌肉相干性，同时心脏形态和功能也出现积极变化。
items.curatedReasonEn: For older women at risk of sarcopenia in the community, 12 weeks of elastic band resistance training significantly improves muscle strength, gait, and even shows positive effects on cardiac morphology and function. These data strongly support prescribing elastic bands as a safe, cost-effective home exercise modality for our sarcopenia-at-risk patients.
items.limitation: 本研究虽然是 RCT，但并未直接证明心-脑-肌网络的整合调节，而是观察到了平行适应。
items.limitationEn: Although an RCT, this study observed parallel adaptations rather than directly demonstrating integrated regulation of the heart-brain-muscle network.

items.title: Effects of resistance training intensity and a dietary protein intervention on psychosocial outcomes, executive function, and quality of life in frail community-dwelling older adults
items.summary: A secondary analysis of an RCT with 295 frail community-dwelling older adults found that 12 weeks of twice-weekly resistance training improved depressive symptoms (β = −0.167), executive function, and quality of life (β = +1.26), with no consistent differences across training intensities or additional benefits from a protein intervention.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究表明，针对衰弱的社区居住老年人，无论训练强度如何，为期 12 周的抗阻训练都能改善抑郁症状、执行功能和生活质量。这意味着在为这类患者设计康复方案时，不必过分强调单一高强度，关键是坚持规律训练。
items.titleZh: 抗阻训练强度和膳食蛋白质干预对衰弱社区老年人心理社会结局、执行功能和生活质量的影响
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 295 名衰弱社区老年人的随机对照试验次要分析发现，每周两次、为期 12 周的抗阻训练能改善抑郁症状 (β = −0.167)、执行功能和生活质量 (β = +1.26)，且不同训练强度和蛋白质干预的额外益处无一致差异。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study indicates that for frail community-dwelling older adults, 12 weeks of resistance training, regardless of intensity, improves depressive symptoms, executive function, and quality of life. This suggests that when designing rehabilitation programs for these patients, consistent training is key, rather than an overemphasis on single high-intensity regimens.
items.limitation: 本研究为 TEAMS 随机对照试验的次要分析，因此结果应谨慎解读，且蛋白质干预未显示出持续的额外益处。
items.limitationEn: This was a secondary analysis of the TEAMS RCT, so findings should be interpreted cautiously, and the protein intervention showed no consistent additional benefits.

items.title: Diagnostic accuracy and discriminative validity of clinician-administered physiotherapy examination tests in adults with nonspecific neck pain: a systematic review
items.summary: This systematic review of 18 studies found that clinician-administered physiotherapy examination tests may help characterize impairment patterns in adults with nonspecific neck pain within sensorimotor, muscle-performance, and movement-control domains, but direct clinical diagnostic-accuracy evidence is lacking, and tests should be adjuncts rather than standalone tools.
items.curatedReason: 现有证据表明，物理治疗师实施的检查测试有助于表征非特异性颈痛患者的损伤模式，尤其是在感觉运动、肌肉表现和特定运动控制方面。但这些测试缺乏直接的临床诊断准确性证据，应作为多模式临床评估的辅助手段，而非独立诊断工具。
items.titleZh: 物理治疗师实施的检查测试对非特异性颈痛成人诊断准确性和鉴别有效性：一项系统综述
items.summaryZh: 这项对 18 项研究的系统综述发现，物理治疗师实施的检查测试可能有助于表征非特异性颈痛成人患者的感觉运动、肌肉表现和运动控制方面的损伤模式，但缺乏直接的临床诊断准确性证据，应将其作为辅助而非独立的诊断工具。
items.curatedReasonEn: Current evidence suggests that clinician-administered physiotherapy examination tests can help characterize impairment patterns in adults with non-specific neck pain, particularly in sensorimotor, muscle performance, and movement control domains. However, these tests lack direct clinical diagnostic accuracy evidence and should be interpreted as adjuncts within a multimodal clinical assessment, not standalone diagnostic tools.
items.limitation: 现有研究大多比较颈痛患者与无症状对照组，缺乏直接的临床诊断准确性证据。
items.limitationEn: Most available evidence comes from studies comparing people with neck pain against asymptomatic controls, lacking direct clinical diagnostic accuracy evidence.

items.title: Effect of lumbar strengthening exercises on kinesiophobia in people with chronic low back pain: a systematic review
items.summary: This systematic review found very-low-certainty evidence insufficient to determine the effectiveness of lumbar strengthening exercises alone for reducing kinesiophobia in individuals with chronic non-specific low back pain, with inconsistent findings across three included RCTs.
items.curatedReason: 现有证据（很低确定性）尚不足以支持腰部强化训练能有效降低慢性非特异性腰痛患者的运动恐惧。你应将重心放在综合干预，而不是单一地依赖强化训练来解决运动恐惧。
items.titleZh: 腰部强化训练对慢性腰痛患者运动恐惧症的影响：一项系统综述
items.summaryZh: 这项系统综述发现，针对慢性非特异性腰痛患者，腰部强化训练单独用于减少运动恐惧症的证据确定性非常低，且三项纳入 RCT 的结果不一致，不足以确定其有效性。
items.curatedReasonEn: Current evidence (very low certainty) is insufficient to conclude that lumbar strengthening exercises alone effectively reduce kinesiophobia in individuals with chronic non-specific low back pain. Focus on comprehensive interventions rather than solely relying on strengthening for kinesiophobia.
items.limitation: 研究纳入的 RCT 数量有限（3 项），且证据确定性为“非常低”。
items.limitationEn: The review included a limited number of RCTs (3) and the overall certainty of evidence was graded as "very low."

items.title: Intermittent theta burst stimulation on the cerebellar Hemisphere to imprOve Post-stroke cognitivE impairment (HOPE): a multicentre randomised controlled double-blind trial
items.summary: The HOPE trial is a multicentre, randomized, double-blind, sham-controlled study investigating the safety and efficacy of intermittent theta burst stimulation (iTBS) on the contralesional cerebellar hemisphere to improve cognitive function in 70 adults with early post-stroke cognitive impairment.
items.curatedReason: 这项协议将探索小脑间歇性 θ 爆发刺激 (iTBS) 对卒中后早期认知障碍的疗效与安全性。如果结果积极，它可能为卒中患者的认知康复提供一种新的非侵入性神经调节策略。
items.titleZh: 小脑半球间歇性 θ 爆发刺激改善卒中后认知障碍 (HOPE)：一项多中心随机对照双盲试验
items.summaryZh: HOPE 试验是一项多中心、随机、双盲、假对照研究，旨在评估对侧小脑半球间歇性 θ 爆发刺激 (iTBS) 在改善 70 名早期卒中后认知障碍成人患者认知功能方面的安全性和有效性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This protocol will explore the efficacy and safety of cerebellar intermittent theta burst stimulation (iTBS) for early post-stroke cognitive impairment. If positive, it could offer a new non-invasive neuromodulation strategy for cognitive rehabilitation in stroke patients.
items.limitation: 本研究为研究方案，最终疗效和安全性仍需等待试验结果。
items.limitationEn: This is a study protocol; final efficacy and safety results are pending trial completion.

items.title: Effect of bimodal signal biofeedback on the supraglottic swallowing maneuver in patients with post-stroke dysphagia: A randomised controlled trial
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial investigated the effect of bimodal signal biofeedback, combining an accelerometer and a nasal airflow sensor, on the supraglottic swallowing maneuver in patients with post-stroke dysphagia.
items.curatedReason: 这项 RCT 提出了针对卒中后吞咽困难患者的创新性生物反馈方案，将加速度计与鼻气流传感器结合，有望提高声门上吞咽动作的有效性。这对你评估和干预这类患者提供了新的思路。
items.titleZh: 双模式信号生物反馈对卒中后吞咽困难患者声门上吞咽动作的影响：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验旨在调查结合加速度计和鼻气流传感器的双模式信号生物反馈对卒中后吞咽困难患者声门上吞咽动作的影响。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT introduces an innovative biofeedback approach for post-stroke dysphagia, combining an accelerometer and nasal airflow sensor to potentially enhance the supraglottic swallowing maneuver. It offers a new perspective for assessing and intervening in these patients.
items.limitation: 试验的具体方法学和结果细节未提供，无法评估研究设计的全面性和结果的精确性。
items.limitationEn: Specific methodological and detailed results were not provided, preventing a comprehensive evaluation of the study design and precision of outcomes.
items.journal: Archives of Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Effectiveness of Kalevala Manual Therapy, Health Coaching, and Physiotherapy for Chronic Low Back Pain: A Randomized Controlled Trial (The INTEGRA Trial)
items.summary: In a three-arm RCT with 81 adults with non-specific chronic low back pain, Kalevala Manual Therapy (KMT) and KMT combined with health coaching (KMT+HC) showed comparable improvements in pain and functional disability to guideline-based physiotherapy, with KMT+HC also significantly reducing work-related fear-avoidance beliefs.
items.curatedReason: 这项 RCT 提示 Kalevala 手法治疗（KMT）及其结合健康指导（KMT+HC）在慢性腰痛的疼痛和功能障碍改善上，与指南推荐的物理治疗效果相当。值得关注的是，KMT+HC 还能显著降低与工作相关的恐惧回避信念，这表明综合性行为支持对手法治疗的补充价值。
items.titleZh: Kalevala 手法治疗、健康指导和物理治疗对慢性腰痛的有效性：一项随机对照试验（INTEGRA 试验）
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 81 名非特异性慢性腰痛成人患者的三臂随机对照试验显示，Kalevala 手法治疗（KMT）和 KMT 结合健康指导（KMT+HC）在改善疼痛和功能障碍方面与指南推荐的物理治疗效果相当，且 KMT+HC 显著降低了与工作相关的恐惧回避信念。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT with 81 chronic low back pain patients tells us that if you're using Kalevala Manual Therapy (KMT), its effects on pain and disability are comparable to guideline-based physiotherapy. What's more compelling is that KMT combined with health coaching (KMT+HC) significantly reduced work-related fear-avoidance beliefs, suggesting that integrating behavioral support into manual therapy is a solid approach.
items.limitation: 本研究为单中心试验，样本量相对较小（81 例），且缺乏长期随访数据，可能限制了结果的普遍性和长期有效性。
items.limitationEn: This was a single-center trial with a relatively small sample size (81 participants) and lacked long-term follow-up, which may limit the generalizability and long-term efficacy of the results.

items.title: Do Subsamples Provide Reproducibility Estimates Comparable to the Full Sample in Trial-Based Ultrasound Muscle Measurements?
items.summary: This study explores whether subsamples provide reproducibility estimates comparable to the full sample in trial-based ultrasound muscle measurements.
items.curatedReason: 这份观察研究的意义在于，它提出在进行超声肌肉测量可重复性研究时，不必每次都收集全样本数据，小样本可能已足够。这可以帮我们节省研究时间和资源，但对临床超声测量操作本身并无直接影响。
items.titleZh: 子样本在基于试验的超声肌肉测量中能否提供与全样本相当的可重复性估计？
items.summaryZh: 本研究探讨了在基于试验的超声肌肉测量中，子样本是否能提供与全样本相当的可重复性估计。
items.curatedReasonEn: This observational study suggests that when evaluating the reproducibility of ultrasound muscle measurements, you might not always need full sample data; subsamples could be sufficient. This could save research time and resources, though it doesn't directly change how we perform clinical ultrasound measurements.
items.journal: Measurement in Physical Education and Exercise Science

items.title: Trajectories of physical activity following digital education and exercise therapy-a longitudinal registry study among 15,197 persons with knee or hip osteoarthritis.
items.summary: A longitudinal registry study of 15,197 individuals with knee or hip osteoarthritis found that participation in a digital education and exercise therapy program increased the proportion reaching recommended physical activity levels from 51.4% to 58.5% at one year. Four distinct physical activity trajectories were identified, with BMI and physical function being key associated factors.
items.curatedReason: 这项大型追踪研究表明，数字教育和运动疗法能有效提升骨关节炎患者的身体活动水平。对 BMI 较高和功能较差的患者，可考虑采取更针对性的干预策略。
items.titleZh: 数字教育和运动疗法对膝髋骨关节炎患者身体活动轨迹的影响：一项 15,197 人的纵向登记研究
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 15,197 例膝关节或髋关节骨关节炎患者的纵向登记研究发现，参与数字教育和运动疗法项目后，达到推荐身体活动水平的患者比例从入组时的 51.4% 上升至一年后的 58.5%。研究识别出四种不同的身体活动轨迹，其中 BMI 和身体功能是主要关联因素。
items.curatedReasonEn: This large longitudinal study demonstrates that digital education and exercise therapy can effectively increase physical activity levels in OA patients. Consider targeted interventions for patients with higher BMI and poorer function.
items.limitation: 该研究主要关注患者报告结局，可能存在报告偏倚。
items.limitationEn: The study primarily focused on patient-reported outcomes, which may introduce reporting bias.

items.title: Development of Enhanced Reviews of Psychological Changes After Stroke (ENRICH): A complex Intervention to Monitor and Support Self-Management of Post-Stroke Psychological Changes Within a Matched Care Model.
items.summary: The Enhanced Reviews of Psychological Changes After Stroke (ENRICH) program is a new complex intervention designed to monitor and support self-management of post-stroke psychological changes. Developed within the UK matched care model, it includes personalized psychoeducation and three brief reviews for individuals with mild to moderate cognitive changes, low mood, anxiety, and fatigue.
items.curatedReason: ENRICH 项目为卒中后轻中度心理变化（情绪、焦虑、疲劳）提供了一个结构化的监测和支持方案。关注其后续的临床有效性测试，这可能为社区康复实践带来新思路。
items.titleZh: 卒中后心理变化增强审查（ENRICH）项目开发：一项支持卒中后心理变化自我管理的复杂干预
items.summaryZh: 卒中后心理变化增强审查（ENRICH）项目是一项新的复杂干预措施，旨在监测和支持卒中后心理变化的自我管理。该项目在英国匹配护理模式下开发，通过个性化心理教育和三次简短复查，为患有轻中度认知改变、情绪低落、焦虑和疲劳的卒中幸存者提供支持。
items.curatedReasonEn: The ENRICH program offers a structured monitoring and support solution for mild to moderate post-stroke psychological changes (mood, anxiety, fatigue). Monitor its upcoming clinical effectiveness testing, as it could introduce new approaches to community rehabilitation practices.

items.title: The Current State of Anterior Cruciate Ligament Reconstruction: Graft Selection, Lateral Augmentation, Rehabilitation, and Return-to-Play.
items.summary: A review of anterior cruciate ligament reconstruction (ACLR) highlights shifts in graft selection (quadriceps tendon autograft increasing), the role of lateral extra-articular tenodesis for high-risk knees, and the evolution of return-to-play criteria from fixed timelines to performance-based assessments. Psychological readiness is identified as an independent factor influencing both return to sport and second ACL injury.
items.curatedReason: 膝关节 ACLR 后，你可能需要重新考虑自体移植物的选择，股四头肌腱的使用正在增加。对高风险膝关节，侧方额外关节外腱固定术的必要性也应纳入考量，且重返赛场的标准必须转向基于表现的评估，而非简单的时间线。请记住，患者的心理准备状态是影响重返运动和二次 ACL 损伤风险的独立因素，务必将其纳入你的康复和风险评估流程中。
items.titleZh: 前交叉韧带重建的现状：移植物选择、侧方加固、康复与重返赛场
items.summaryZh: 一篇关于前交叉韧带重建（ACLR）的综述强调了移植物选择（股四头肌腱自体移植物增加）的变化、高危膝关节侧方关节外腱固定术的作用，以及重返赛场标准从固定时间线向基于表现评估的演变。心理准备状态被认为是影响重返运动和第二次 ACL 损伤的独立因素。
items.curatedReasonEn: For ACLR, reconsider your autograft choice; quadriceps tendon use is on the rise. Lateral extra-articular tenodesis should be considered for high-risk knees, and return-to-play criteria must shift to performance-based assessments, not just fixed timelines. Importantly, psychological readiness is an independent factor influencing both return to sport and the risk of a second ACL injury, so ensure you integrate this into your rehabilitation and risk assessment.
items.limitation: 这是一篇叙述性综述，可能存在作者偏倚且未进行系统性文献检索。
items.limitationEn: As a narrative review, it may be subject to author bias and lacks systematic literature search methodology.

items.title: Photobiomodulation therapy has a negligible effect as an adjunct to motor control exercise in people with chronic non-specific low back pain: a randomised trial.
items.summary: Adding photobiomodulation therapy (PBMT) to motor control exercise (MCE) provided negligible additional improvements in pain intensity (MD -0.4 points), disability (MD -0.7 points), or circulating PGE2 concentrations compared with sham PBMT plus MCE at 6 weeks and throughout 12-month follow-up in 148 adults with chronic non-specific low back pain.
items.curatedReason: 这项高质量 RCT 显示，对于慢性非特异性腰痛，在运动控制训练中额外加入光生物调节疗法（HILT）并不能带来具有临床意义的额外改善，无论是短期还是长达 12 个月的随访。这进一步巩固了主动运动干预作为核心的地位，提醒你避免过度依赖被动物理因子。
items.titleZh: 慢性非特异性腰痛患者：光生物调节疗法作为运动控制训练辅助手段效果甚微：一项随机试验
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 148 名慢性非特异性腰痛患者的随机对照试验显示，在 6 周时，相比于安慰剂加运动控制训练，额外加入光生物调节疗法（PBMT）未能显著改善疼痛强度（平均差 -0.4 分）、残疾（平均差 -0.7 分）或循环前列腺素 E2 浓度，且 12 个月随访期内差异也微乎其微。
items.curatedReasonEn: This high-quality RCT demonstrates that adding photobiomodulation therapy (PBMT) to motor control exercise (MCE) provides no clinically important additional improvements for chronic non-specific low back pain, neither short-term nor at 12-month follow-up. This reinforces the primacy of active exercise interventions and cautions against over-reliance on passive modalities.
items.limitation: 研究未详细报告运动控制训练的具体内容与强度，可能影响结果的可推广性。
items.limitationEn: The study did not detail the specific content and intensity of the motor control exercise, which might affect the generalizability of the results.

items.title: Post burn Cubital Tunnel Syndrome Electrophysiological and Functional Responses to High intensity Laser Therapy versus Extracorporeal Shock Wave Therapy: A Randomized Controlled Trial.
items.summary: In 75 patients with post-burn cubital tunnel syndrome, both HILT+UNGE and ESWT+UNGE improved nerve conduction and upper-limb function more than UNGE alone. HILT resulted in significantly greater improvements than ESWT across all electrophysiological outcomes and DASH scores, with benefits maintained at 12-week follow-up.
items.curatedReason: 这项随机对照试验表明，对于烧伤后肘管综合征，结合高强度激光疗法（HILT）或体外冲击波疗法（ESWT）的尺神经滑动练习比单独滑动练习更有效，且 HILT 在神经电生理和功能结局上优于 ESWT。你可以考虑将 HILT 作为烧伤后 CuTS 患者的有效治疗选择，尤其是在电生理改善方面。
items.titleZh: 烧伤后肘管综合征：高强度激光疗法与体外冲击波疗法对电生理和功能反应的随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 75 名烧伤后肘管综合征患者的随机对照试验显示，高强度激光疗法（HILT）加尺神经滑动练习（UNGE）和体外冲击波疗法（ESWT）加 UNGE 均比单独 UNGE 更能改善神经传导和上肢功能。HILT 在所有电生理指标和 DASH 评分上均优于 ESWT，且效果在 12 周随访时保持。
items.curatedReasonEn: This randomized controlled trial indicates that, for post-burn cubital tunnel syndrome, ulnar nerve gliding exercises combined with either high-intensity laser therapy (HILT) or extracorporeal shock wave therapy (ESWT) are more effective than gliding exercises alone, with HILT being superior to ESWT in electrophysiological and functional outcomes. You may consider HILT as an effective treatment option for post-burn CuTS patients, especially for electrophysiological improvements.
items.limitation: 随访期相对较短（12 周），长期效果尚需更多研究确认。
items.limitationEn: The follow-up period is relatively short (12 weeks), and long-term effects require further confirmation.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

items.title: Fall prevention interventions among older adults in low-and middle-income countries (LMICs): an integrative review.
items.summary: An integrative review of 14 studies from seven low- and middle-income countries found that multifactorial interventions, exercise-based programs, and home safety modifications may reduce fall incidence, fall risk, and fear of falling among older adults, although evidence on contextual adaptation and scalability remains limited.
items.curatedReason: 这项综合性综述指出，在低收入和中等收入国家，运动、多因素干预和家庭安全改造可有效降低老年人跌倒风险。它支持你将力量、平衡和环境风险评估纳入跌倒预防项目，但也要留意将高收入国家经验本土化的挑战。
items.titleZh: 低收入和中等收入国家（LMICs）老年人跌倒预防干预措施：一项综合性综述
items.summaryZh: 一项对七个低收入和中等收入国家的 14 项研究进行的综合性综述发现，多因素干预、运动项目和家庭安全改造可能降低老年人的跌倒发生率、跌倒风险和跌倒恐惧，但关于其背景适应性和可扩展性的证据仍然有限。
items.curatedReasonEn: This integrative review indicates that exercise, multifactorial interventions, and home safety modifications can effectively reduce fall risk among older adults in low- and middle-income countries. It supports your inclusion of strength, balance, and environmental risk assessments in fall prevention programs, but also alerts you to the challenges of localizing high-income country experiences.
items.limitation: 纳入的研究数量有限，且干预措施和结果测量的异质性较高，可能影响结论的稳健性。
items.limitationEn: The limited number of included studies and high heterogeneity in interventions and outcome measures may affect the robustness of the conclusions.

items.title: Development of a Communication Characteristics Module for Autistic Adults and the Creation of a Communication Profile Variable
items.summary: The AASPIRE Outcomes Project developed a 10-item Communication Characteristics module and a five-level Communication Profile variable for autistic adults. Tested with 844 adults, the module showed high completion feasibility and strong construct validity, while the profile variable demonstrated strong construct validity and substantial test-retest reliability (kappa = 0.69).
items.curatedReason: 这份预印本提出了一个量化自闭症成人沟通特征的模块和沟通档案变量，对于理解沟通多样性、优化研究分组和干预策略具有潜在价值。它提示你未来可以利用这类工具更精细地评估和支持自闭症患者的康复需求。
items.titleZh: 自闭症成人沟通特征模块的开发及沟通档案变量的创建
items.summaryZh: AASPIRE 成果项目开发了一个 10 项沟通特征模块和五级沟通档案变量，用于描述自闭症成人的沟通。在对 844 名成人进行测试后，该模块表现出高完成可行性和强大的结构效度，而沟通档案变量则显示出强大的结构效度及显著的重测信度（kappa = 0.69）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This preprint proposes a module and communication profile variable for quantifying communication characteristics in autistic adults, with potential value for understanding communication diversity, optimizing research stratification, and intervention strategies. It suggests that you could utilize such tools in the future to more precisely assess and support the rehabilitation needs of autistic individuals.
items.limitation: 本研究为预印本，尚未经过同行评审，且为自愿报告形式，可能存在报告偏倚。
items.limitationEn: This study is a preprint and has not yet undergone peer review; being self-reported, it may have reporting bias.

items.title: The effect of functional inspiratory muscle training on diaphragm function and core stabilisation in patients with chronic non-specific low back pain: a randomised controlled trial
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial (N=40) found that a 10-week multicomponent functional inspiratory muscle training (F-IMT) program significantly improved diaphragm thickness (adjusted difference, 2.434 mm; 95% CI, 1.714 to 3.261; P < .001) and mobility, reduced pain, and increased respiratory muscle strength and core endurance in patients with chronic non-specific low back pain, compared to thoracic expansion exercises.
items.curatedReason: 对于慢性非特异性腰痛患者，功能性吸气肌训练（F-IMT）值得纳入康复方案。这项 RCT 证明，一个 10 周的多组分 F-IMT 计划能显著改善患者的膈肌功能、核心耐力，并减轻疼痛。
items.titleZh: 功能性吸气肌训练对慢性非特异性腰痛患者膈肌功能和核心稳定的影响：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验（N=40）发现，与胸廓扩张运动相比，为期 10 周的多组分功能性吸气肌训练（F-IMT）方案显著改善了慢性非特异性腰痛患者的膈肌厚度（调整后差异 2.434 毫米；95% CI 1.714 至 3.261；P < .001）和活动度，并减轻了疼痛，增强了呼吸肌力量和核心耐力。
items.curatedReasonEn: For patients with chronic non-specific low back pain, functional inspiratory muscle training (F-IMT) should be considered in rehabilitation programs. This RCT demonstrates that a 10-week multicomponent F-IMT program significantly improves diaphragm function, core endurance, and reduces pain.
items.limitation: 这项研究仅使用了膈肌厚度作为主要结局指标，可能需要更多与临床功能直接相关的结局来进一步验证。
items.limitationEn: This study primarily used diaphragm thickness as the main outcome, and further validation with more clinically relevant functional outcomes may be needed.

items.title: Continuity of care interventions for people with stroke and their caregivers: a scoping review of randomized controlled trials.
items.summary: A scoping review of 80 randomized controlled trials identified 65 continuity of care interventions for stroke patients (PwS) and/or their caregivers. Most interventions focused on PwS only and addressed transitions from acute inpatient management to home care, with an average of two of three continuity of care dimensions and two of four family-centered care components addressed.
items.curatedReason: 这项综述发现中风患者的连续性护理干预多集中在急性期到居家护理的过渡，且常常只关注患者。你需要在制定干预方案时，更多地将照护者纳入进来，并关注全病程的过渡需求。
items.titleZh: 中风患者及其照护者的连续性护理干预：一项随机对照试验的范围综述
items.summaryZh: 一项对 80 项随机对照试验进行的范围综述，识别了 65 项针对中风患者和/或其照护者的连续性护理干预。大多数干预措施仅关注中风患者，并侧重于从急性住院管理到居家护理的过渡，平均仅涵盖连续性护理的维度和以家庭为中心护理的组成部分。
items.curatedReasonEn: This review found that continuity of care interventions for stroke patients often focus only on the patient and the transition from acute to home care. When designing interventions, you should include caregivers more actively and address transitions across the entire continuum of care.
items.limitation: 该综述仅限于RCT研究，可能未能涵盖其他类型研究中提出的有效干预措施。
items.limitationEn: This review was limited to RCTs, potentially excluding effective interventions discussed in other study designs.

items.title: Technical and clinical feasibility of a pulmonary telerehabilitation model for people with COPD.
items.summary: A two-phase feasibility study (N=20 per phase) found that a home-based pulmonary telerehabilitation (HBPR) program for COPD patients was technically and clinically feasible. Device data transmission showed ≥99% clinical agreement, 95% of participants completed the 8-week program with high satisfaction (CSQ-8 median 30), and endurance time increased (median 171.00 seconds, 95% CI 17.00 to 725.00).
items.curatedReason: 这项初步的二期可行性研究显示，远程肺康复（HBPR）在 COPD 患者中技术和临床上均可行，且患者满意度高。你可以考虑将此模式作为未来患者管理的备选项，但还需等待大规模 RCT 证实其临床疗效。
items.titleZh: 慢性阻塞性肺病患者肺部远程康复模型的技术与临床可行性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项两阶段可行性研究（每阶段 20 名受试者）发现，针对慢阻肺患者的居家肺部远程康复（HBPR）项目在技术和临床上均可行。设备数据传输临床一致性达 99% 以上，95% 的受试者完成了 8 周项目，满意度高（CSQ-8 中位数 30），且耐力时间有所增加（中位数 171.00 秒，95% CI 17.00 至 725.00）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This preliminary Phase 2 feasibility study indicates that telerehabilitation for COPD patients (HBPR) is technically and clinically feasible, with high patient satisfaction. You can consider this model for future patient management, but large-scale RCTs are needed to confirm its clinical efficacy.
items.limitation: 这项单中心的可行性研究样本量较小，且缺乏对照组，无法确证临床疗效。
items.limitationEn: This single-center feasibility study had a small sample size and lacked a control group, preventing definitive conclusions on clinical efficacy.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

items.title: Does prehabilitation with exercise improve clinical outcomes of arthroscopic modified Broström procedure in patients with chronic lateral ankle instability: a prospective cohort study
items.summary: A prospective cohort study (N=276) found that a 4-week exercise-based prehabilitation program before arthroscopic modified Broström procedure for chronic lateral ankle instability was associated with significantly higher total FAOS scores at 2 years (92.4 vs. 80.0), better functional recovery, and faster return to sports compared to standard care, with benefits maintained at 24 months.
items.curatedReason: 这项前瞻性队列研究提示，对于慢性外踝不稳行 Broström 手术的患者，术前康复能带来更好的患者报告结局和更快的运动回归。虽然不是随机对照研究，但你可以在临床中将其作为优化术后恢复的辅助策略，同时继续关注相关 RCT 证据。
items.titleZh: 运动康复预训练能否改善慢性外踝不稳患者关节镜改良 Broström 手术的临床结局：一项前瞻性队列研究
items.summaryZh: 一项前瞻性队列研究（N=276）发现，针对慢性外踝不稳患者在关节镜改良 Broström 手术前进行为期 4 周的运动预康复计划，与标准护理相比，两年时总 FAOS 评分显著更高（92.4 对 80.0），功能恢复更佳，并能更快重返运动，且益处在 24 个月时仍保持。
items.curatedReasonEn: This prospective cohort study suggests that prehabilitation improves patient-reported outcomes and accelerates return to sport for patients undergoing the Broström procedure for chronic lateral ankle instability. While not an RCT, you can consider this as an adjunct strategy to optimize postoperative recovery, while staying informed on future RCT evidence.
items.limitation: 这是一项前瞻性队列研究，非随机化设计可能存在选择偏倚。
items.limitationEn: This was a prospective cohort study, and its non-randomized design may introduce selection bias.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Here are the Speech Language Therapy Coding Changes Going Into Effect on January 1, 2027
items.summary: The CPT Editorial Panel is replacing speech-language therapy code 92507 with ten new, more specific codes effective January 1, 2027. These new codes are structured to cover fluency disorders, speech sound production disorders, language comprehension and expression disorders, combined speech sound production and language disorders, and voice/upper airway dysfunction/resonance disorders.
items.curatedReason: 这项新闻介绍了言语治疗的 CPT 编码在 2027 年 1 月 1 日的修订。这些变化主要影响言语治疗师，物理治疗师只需了解即可，与你的直接执业影响不大。
items.titleZh: 言语治疗编码变更将于 2027 年 1 月 1 日生效
items.summaryZh: CPT 编辑委员会决定自 2027 年 1 月 1 日起，用十个新的、更具体的编码取代言语治疗编码 92507。这些新编码旨在涵盖流利性障碍、言语发音障碍、语言理解和表达障碍、言语发音与语言综合障碍以及发音/上呼吸道功能障碍/共鸣障碍。
items.curatedReasonEn: This news covers the CPT coding revisions for speech-language therapy effective January 1, 2027. These changes primarily affect speech-language pathologists; physical therapists should be aware but are not directly impacted in their practice.

items.title: PTJ Author Interview: Severe Spinal Stenosis and Exercise-Based Rehabilitation
items.summary: An APTA podcast interview with Bahar Shahidi, PT, DPT, PhD, discusses her recent study showing that exercise-based rehabilitation yields similar improvements in patients with mild, moderate, or severe radiographic spinal stenosis. The discussion covers how imaging influences clinical decision-making and the specific benefits of exercise in this population.
items.curatedReason: 这项访谈强调，放射学影像显示的腰椎管狭窄严重程度并不影响患者对运动康复的反应。这意味着你不应该仅根据影像结果就排除运动疗法，即使是重度狭窄的患者也应优先考虑非手术康复。
items.titleZh: PTJ 作者访谈：重度脊柱管狭窄与运动康复
items.summaryZh: APTA 播客访谈了物理治疗博士 Bahar Shahidi，讨论了她最近的研究，该研究发现运动康复在影像学显示轻度、中度或重度脊柱管狭窄的患者中能带来同等幅度的改善。访谈内容包括影像学如何影响临床决策以及运动康复在此类人群中的特定益处。
items.curatedReasonEn: This interview highlights that radiographic severity of lumbar spinal stenosis does not impact responsiveness to exercise-based rehabilitation. This means you should not rule out exercise therapy based solely on imaging results; even patients with severe stenosis should be prioritized for non-surgical rehabilitation.

items.title: Recovery strategies, training volume, and performance in Japanese recreational marathon runners: a cross-sectional study
items.summary: A cross-sectional questionnaire survey (N=5,204) of Japanese recreational marathon runners found bathing (86.5%), stretching (85.0%), hot spring use (66.7%), and massage (47.0%) were the most common recovery strategies. Active recovery, contrast baths, and acupuncture/moxibustion showed modest associations with shorter personal best marathon times and higher monthly training volume.
items.curatedReason: 别轻易推荐跑者做主动恢复、冷热交替浴或针灸来提高成绩，这项针对 5,204 名日本跑者的横断面调查只发现它们与更短的马拉松最好成绩和更高的月训练量有微弱关联。不过，你可以了解患者最常用的恢复策略是洗浴（86.5%）、拉伸（85.0%）、温泉（66.7%）和按摩（47.0%）。
items.titleZh: 日本休闲马拉松跑者的恢复策略、训练量与表现：一项横断面研究
items.summaryZh: 一项针对日本休闲马拉松跑者进行的横断面问卷调查（N=5,204）发现，洗浴（86.5%）、拉伸（85.0%）、温泉（66.7%）和按摩（47.0%）是最常见的恢复策略。主动恢复、冷热交替浴以及针灸/艾灸与更短的个人最好马拉松成绩和更高的月训练量存在适度关联。
items.curatedReasonEn: Do not readily recommend active recovery, contrast baths, or acupuncture to runners for performance enhancement; this cross-sectional survey of 5,204 Japanese runners only found modest associations with shorter marathon personal best times and higher monthly training volume. However, you should note that patients most commonly use bathing (86.5%), stretching (85.0%), hot springs (66.7%), and massage (47.0%) as recovery strategies.
items.limitation: 这是一项横断面描述性研究，无法建立因果关系，且回复率较低（3.0%）可能限制了结果的代表性。
items.limitationEn: This was a cross-sectional descriptive study, unable to establish causality, and a low response rate (3.0%) may limit the representativeness of the findings.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Value-Based Care: APTA Resources to Help You Prepare
items.summary: APTA has compiled and updated resources to help physical therapists understand and prepare for the shift towards value-based care models, which are becoming more prominent in healthcare payment and delivery. These resources address how different payment models work, necessary practice capabilities, and how to evaluate agreements.
items.curatedReason: APTA 发布了系列资源以帮助物理治疗师应对日益增长的价值医疗模式。这提示你需要了解并开始准备应对这种支付和交付模式的变化，以确保你的实践能有效展示 PT 服务的价值。
items.titleZh: 价值医疗：APTA 资源助您做好准备
items.summaryZh: APTA 汇编并更新了资源，旨在帮助物理治疗师理解并为向价值医疗模式的转变做好准备，该模式在医疗支付和交付中日益突出。这些资源涵盖了不同支付模式的运作方式、实践所需能力以及如何评估协议等问题。
items.curatedReasonEn: APTA has released resources to help physical therapists navigate the growing value-based care model. This indicates you need to understand and prepare for changes in this payment and delivery model to ensure your practice can effectively demonstrate the value of PT services.

items.title: Keeping Pace in a Changing Healthcare Landscape
items.summary: This article discusses the need for rehab therapy practices to adapt to a changing healthcare landscape, addressing patient demands for convenience, provider struggles with documentation, billing team needs for efficient claims management, and owners' need for operational insights. It emphasizes a new approach to meet the expectations of patients, payers, and providers amidst increasing competition and tighter economics.
items.curatedReason: 这篇行业评论文章指出，康复治疗实践需要适应不断变化的患者期望、提供者需求和支付方要求。这提醒你在规划实践运营时，需关注市场竞争、患者便利性、提供者文档负担和账单管理效率，以保持竞争力。
items.titleZh: 在不断变化的医疗格局中保持领先
items.summaryZh: 本文探讨了康复治疗实践需适应不断变化的医疗格局，以应对患者对便利性的需求、提供者在文档方面的困境、计费团队对高效索赔管理的需求以及所有者对运营洞察的需求。文章强调了一种新方法，以在日益激烈的竞争和更紧张的经济环境下满足患者、支付方和提供者的期望。
items.curatedReasonEn: This industry commentary highlights that rehab therapy practices need to adapt to evolving patient expectations, provider needs, and payer demands. This reminds you that when planning practice operations, you need to focus on market competition, patient convenience, provider documentation burden, and billing management efficiency to stay competitive.

items.title: Upright Participation for Learners with Physical Disabilities: A Pilot Randomized Crossover Effectiveness-Implementation Trial of Robot-assisted Walking in Schools
items.summary: A pilot randomized crossover trial (n=8) found robot-assisted walking in schools feasible, with device use ranging 48-96 minutes/week. It showed potential effectiveness for children with physical disabilities, with a mean COPM change of 3.56 (SD 1.07) for intervention vs 2.11 (SD 2.41) for control (dz=0.74).
items.curatedReason: 机器人辅助步行在学校环境中实施的可行性得到了初步验证，且对提高有肢体残疾儿童的参与度有积极潜力。你可以期待未来更明确的随机对照试验结果。
items.titleZh: 肢体残疾学生在校直立参与：机器人辅助步行在学校的试点随机交叉效应-实施试验
items.summaryZh: 一项试点随机交叉试验（n=8）评估了在学校实施机器人辅助步行的可行性与潜在效果。结果显示，设备周使用时间为48-96分钟，对肢体残疾儿童的参与度有积极潜力（COPM平均变化：干预组3.56，对照组2.11；dz=0.74）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This pilot study provides preliminary evidence for the feasibility of robot-assisted walking in schools and its potential to increase participation for children with physical disabilities. Expect definitive RCT results in the future.
items.limitation: 本研究为小样本（8名儿童）试点随机交叉试验，主要评估实施策略和程序，而非最终疗效。
items.limitationEn: This was a small-sample (8 children) pilot randomized crossover trial primarily evaluating implementation strategies and procedures, not definitive efficacy.

items.title: CMS News: Trump Administration Announces $32 Million to Recruit Rural Doctors, Train Healthcare Workers and Expand Emergency Mental Healthcare Across Mississippi
items.summary: The Trump administration announced a $32 million allocation for Mississippi to recruit rural doctors, train healthcare workers, and expand emergency mental healthcare services.
items.curatedReason: 特朗普政府宣布为密西西比州拨款，用于农村医生招聘、医疗工作者培训和紧急精神卫生保健。这可能间接影响该地区物理治疗师的职业环境，因为医疗人力资源的整体提升会带来系统性变化。
items.titleZh: CMS新闻：特朗普政府宣布拨款3200万美元用于密西西比州农村医生招聘、医疗工作者培训和紧急精神卫生保健
items.summaryZh: 特朗普政府宣布将向密西西比州拨款，以支持农村医生招聘、医疗工作者培训和扩大紧急精神卫生保健服务。
items.curatedReasonEn: The Trump administration announced $32 million for Mississippi to recruit rural doctors, train healthcare workers, and expand emergency mental healthcare. This may indirectly affect the professional landscape for physical therapists in the region due to overall healthcare workforce improvements.

items.title: Leading Employers Back Expansion of Electronic Prior Authorization to Self-Funded Health Plans
items.summary: Leading employers are supporting the expansion of electronic prior authorization (ePA) requirements to self-funded health plans, aiming to streamline administrative processes and improve patient access to care.
items.curatedReason: 大型雇主联盟正在推动将电子预授权（ePA）要求扩展到企业自保医疗计划，这将直接影响 PT 诊所处理这类患者报销的流程，预计会提高效率但要求系统适应。
items.titleZh: 大型雇主支持将电子预授权扩展至企业自保医疗计划
items.summaryZh: 大型雇主联盟正推动将电子预授权（ePA）要求扩展到企业自保医疗计划，旨在简化管理流程并改善患者就医可及性。
items.curatedReasonEn: A leading employer coalition is advocating for the expansion of electronic prior authorization (ePA) requirements to self-funded health plans. This will directly impact PT clinics' reimbursement processes for these patients, likely increasing efficiency but requiring system adaptation.

items.title: Delivering a high-dose walking booster program after stroke: a multimethod study of therapists' beliefs and experiences nested within a randomized trial.
items.summary: This multimethod study explored intervention therapists' beliefs and experiences delivering a high-dose walking booster program (HiWalk) within a Phase II trial (n=6 therapists) for stroke survivors (>6 months post-stroke). Therapists largely believed high-dose training was important (98.5/100) but were less confident about patients completing 3 hours/day (74.8/100). Training, team support, and resources facilitated delivery, while beliefs about stroke survivor capability and resource limitations were barriers.
items.curatedReason: 高剂量步行训练的依从性在卒中康复中至关重要。本研究揭示，治疗师需要更强的信心和更多资源来确保患者达到高训练量，这是未来临床方案设计和实施的考量点。
items.titleZh: 卒中后高剂量步行强化训练的实施：一项多方法研究，探讨治疗师在随机试验中的信念和经验
items.summaryZh: 这项多方法研究探索了在二期临床试验背景下（n=6 名治疗师），干预治疗师在为卒中幸存者（卒中后超过 6 个月）提供高剂量步行强化训练（HiWalk）时的信念和经验。治疗师普遍认为高剂量训练很重要（98.5/100），但对患者每天完成 3 小时训练的信心较低（74.8/100）。培训、团队支持和资源是促进因素，而对患者能力的信念和资源限制是障碍。
items.curatedReasonEn: Adherence to high-dose walking training is crucial in stroke rehabilitation. This study reveals therapists need stronger confidence and more resources to ensure patients achieve high training volumes, which are key considerations for future clinical program design and implementation.
items.limitation: 本研究是在一个小型二期临床试验（n=6 名治疗师）背景下进行的，结果的普适性受限。
items.limitationEn: This study was conducted within the context of a small Phase II clinical trial (n=6 therapists), limiting the generalizability of the findings.

items.title: Early postoperative functional exercise adherence and its association with 3-month hip functional recovery among older adults after femoral neck fracture surgery: a prospective observational study.
items.summary: This prospective observational study (n=230 older adults) found that early postoperative functional exercise adherence before discharge was moderate (mean score 49.9 ± 6.9) among older adults after femoral neck fracture surgery. Higher adherence was associated with better 3-month hip functional recovery (Harris Hip Score, B = 0.842, p < 0.001). Kinesiophobia, rehabilitation self-efficacy, social support, and pain intensity were key associated factors.
items.curatedReason: 股骨颈骨折术后早期功能锻炼依从性影响患者 3 个月时的髋关节功能，表明早期康复环节是远期预后的关键。您需要关注患者的恐惧症、自我效能和疼痛管理，并在出院前制定明确的康复计划。
items.titleZh: 老年股骨颈骨折术后早期功能锻炼依从性及其与 3 个月髋关节功能恢复的关联：一项前瞻性观察研究
items.summaryZh: 这项前瞻性观察研究（n=230 名老年人）发现，老年股骨颈骨折术后出院前的早期功能锻炼依从性处于中等水平（平均分 49.9 ± 6.9）。较高的依从性与 3 个月时更好的髋关节功能恢复相关（Harris 髋关节评分，B = 0.842，p < 0.001）。运动恐惧症、康复自我效能、社会支持和疼痛强度是关键的相关因素。
items.curatedReasonEn: Early functional exercise adherence after femoral neck fracture surgery impacts 3-month hip function, highlighting the criticality of early rehabilitation for long-term prognosis. Focus on managing kinesiophobia, enhancing self-efficacy, and pain, alongside clear pre-discharge rehabilitation plans.
items.limitation: 本研究为前瞻性观察研究，尽管发现依从性与功能恢复相关，但无法确立因果关系。
items.limitationEn: This was a prospective observational study, and while it found an association between adherence and functional recovery, it cannot establish causality.

items.title: A Foundational Balance Training Exercise Program for People with Blindness or Low Vision
items.summary: A foundational balance training exercise program is presented for individuals with blindness or low vision, addressing the increased challenges they face with balance and safe mobility due to reduced visual input.
items.curatedReason: 对于视力障碍患者，平衡训练是刚需，因为他们跌倒风险更高。这个基础训练方案是可直接上手的，建议你用于改善患者的平衡能力和移动安全性。
items.titleZh: 视力障碍人群的基础平衡训练方案
items.summaryZh: 一项针对盲人或低视力人群的基础平衡训练方案被提出，旨在解决他们因视力受损在平衡和安全移动方面面临的挑战。
items.curatedReasonEn: Balance training is non-negotiable for individuals with visual impairment given their heightened fall risk. This foundational program is ready for immediate implementation to improve your patients' balance and mobility safety.
items.limitation: 本条目未提及具体研究设计，其通用性可能受限于未说明的实施环境和样本特征。
items.limitationEn: This entry does not specify a research design, and its generalizability may be limited by unstated implementation settings and sample characteristics.
items.journal: Archives of Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Physiotherapists' perspectives on direct access in a referral-based system in Austria - A qualitative study.
items.summary: Physiotherapists in Austria perceive readiness for direct access but identify gaps in confidence, legal framework, and training needs, suggesting targeted education and support are crucial for implementation.
items.curatedReason: 奥地利物理治疗师已准备好直接执业，但法律和培训方面的顾虑会阻碍其落地。你需要关注这些明确指出的障碍，而不是认为障碍不存在。
items.titleZh: 奥地利转诊制度下物理治疗师对直接准入的看法——一项定性研究
items.summaryZh: 奥地利物理治疗师认为自己已为直接准入做好准备，但缺乏信心、法律框架和培训方面的不足。这表明有针对性的教育和支持对于实施至关重要。
items.curatedReasonEn: Austrian PTs are ready for direct access, but legal concerns and training gaps are significant barriers. Pay attention to these identified obstacles, rather than assuming they are already resolved.
items.limitation: 样本量小且为定性数据，可能限制其普遍适用性。
items.limitationEn: Qualitative data from a small sample size may limit generalizability.

items.title: Physiotherapy management of persistent pelvic pain.
items.summary: This review likely consolidates current evidence on physiotherapy management for persistent pelvic pain.
items.curatedReason: 这篇综述巩固了持续性盆腔痛的物理治疗管理证据，建议密切关注其对临床实践的具体推荐。
items.titleZh: 持久性盆腔疼痛的物理治疗管理
items.summaryZh: 该综述可能汇集了持久性盆腔疼痛的物理治疗管理现状证据。鉴于盆腔疼痛疾病的普遍性，这对管理复杂患者群体的临床医生来说是一个坚实的更新，但其实际影响取决于所提供建议的力度。
items.curatedReasonEn: This review likely consolidates current evidence on physiotherapy management for persistent pelvic pain. Given the prevalence of pelvic pain conditions, this is a solid update for clinicians managing this complex patient population, though its practical impact depends on the strength of the recommendations provided.

items.title: Financial burden, non-medical drivers of health, and early caregiving role formation after stroke: a scoping review.
items.summary: Caregiver assessments for stroke recovery inconsistently capture financial toxicity and non-medical drivers of health, indicating a need for more comprehensive instruments integrating these domains with caregiver role formation.
items.curatedReason: 卒中后照护者评估未能全面纳入财务负担和非医疗健康驱动因素，需要开发更全面的工具来应对这些问题。
items.titleZh: 卒中后经济负担、健康非医疗驱动因素与早期照护者角色形成：一项范围综述
items.summaryZh: 卒中后照护者评估不一致地捕捉财务毒性和健康非医疗驱动因素，表明需要更全面的工具将这些领域与照护者角色形成相结合。
items.curatedReasonEn: This scoping review highlights significant gaps in how caregiver assessments capture financial toxicity and non-medical drivers of health post-stroke. It provides a clear call to action for developing more comprehensive assessment tools to better support stroke survivors and their families during recovery.
items.limitation: 范围审查的局限性与检索策略及纳入研究类型有关。
items.limitationEn: Scoping review limitations related to search strategy and included study types.

items.title: Credibility and strength of evidence for exercise, nutritional, and combined interventions on muscle function and physical performance in older adults: an umbrella review of meta-analyses of randomized controlled trials
items.summary: An umbrella review of meta-analyses found the strongest evidence for exercise interventions in older adults, especially for fall prevention. Nutrition-only interventions may modestly benefit muscle mass in specific populations, and combined interventions show some promise for strength and function.
items.curatedReason: 这项伞形综述建议，在老年人干预中，以预防跌倒为目标的运动疗法证据最为充分。营养干预可能仅在特定人群中对肌肉量有适度益处，联合干预在力量和功能方面显示出一定潜力，但运动仍是核心。
items.titleZh: 运动、营养和联合干预对老年人肌肉功能和身体机能的证据可信度和强度：一项随机对照试验荟萃分析的伞形综述
items.summaryZh: 一项荟萃分析的伞形综述发现，老年人中最有力的证据支持运动干预，特别是用于跌倒预防。单独的营养干预可能对特定人群的肌肉质量有适度益处，联合干预在改善力量和功能方面显示出一些前景。
items.curatedReasonEn: This umbrella review of meta-analyses suggests that exercise-based interventions, particularly for fall prevention, have the most consistently supported evidence in older adults. While nutrition may benefit muscle mass in specific groups, and combined interventions show some promise, exercise remains a cornerstone.
items.limitation: 大量综述重叠、临床异质性以及原始综述质量参差不齐，限制了结论的确定性。
items.limitationEn: Significant review overlap, clinical heterogeneity, and variable quality of source reviews limit the certainty of conclusions.

items.title:
Clinical and functional outcomes of aquatic plyometrics in adolescent patellofemoral pain syndrome: a dual-arm randomized controlled trial
							| Journal of Rehabilitation Medicine
items.summary: A dual-arm RCT found aquatic plyometric exercises significantly improved pain, quadriceps and hamstring torque, functional disability, and quality of life in adolescents with patellofemoral pain syndrome compared to conventional exercises.
items.curatedReason: 这项RCT证实，与传统锻炼相比，水中增强式训练能显著改善青少年髌骨股骨疼痛综合征患者的疼痛、股四头肌和腘绳肌力量、功能障碍及生活质量。应考虑将其纳入临床实践。
items.titleZh: 青少年髌股疼痛综合征患者水生增强式训练的临床和功能结局：一项双臂随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项双臂随机对照试验显示，与常规练习相比，水生增强式练习能显著改善青少年髌股疼痛综合征患者的疼痛、股四头肌和腘绳肌扭矩、功能障碍和生活质量。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT provides strong evidence that aquatic plyometrics are superior to conventional exercises for improving pain, strength, function, and quality of life in adolescents with patellofemoral pain syndrome. Clinicians should consider incorporating this intervention.
items.limitation: 本研究在沙特阿拉伯进行；其结果推广至其他人群需谨慎考虑。
items.limitationEn: Study conducted in Saudi Arabia; generalizability to other populations needs consideration.

items.title:
Six-month supervised telerehabilitation combining pilates-based therapeutic exercise and self-myofascial release in adults with fibromyalgia: a randomized controlled trial
							| Journal of Rehabilitation Medicine
items.summary: A 6-month supervised telerehabilitation program combining Pilates-based exercise and self-myofascial release significantly improved fibromyalgia impact, sleep quality, depressive symptoms, and perceived stress compared to usual care in adults with fibromyalgia.
items.curatedReason: 这项高质量RCT表明，为期6个月的结合了普拉提和自我筋膜松解的监督式远程康复计划，在改善纤维肌痛患者的疾病影响、睡眠质量和心理健康方面，显著优于常规护理。这是远程医疗干预的有力循证选择。
items.titleZh: 结合了普拉提式治疗性运动和自我筋膜松解的为期六个月的监督远程康复对成人纤维肌痛症的影响：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项为期六个月的监督式多组分远程康复计划，结合了普拉提式练习和自我筋膜松解，与常规护理相比，显著改善了纤维肌痛症患者的纤维肌痛症影响、睡眠质量、抑郁症状和感知压力。
items.curatedReasonEn: This high-quality RCT demonstrates that a 6-month supervised telerehabilitation program combining Pilates and self-myofascial release significantly improves fibromyalgia impact, sleep quality, and psychological outcomes compared to usual care. This offers a strong evidence-based option for telehealth delivery.
items.limitation: 本研究在希腊进行；未评估超出6个月的长期效果。
items.limitationEn: Study conducted in Greece; long-term effects beyond 6 months were not assessed.

items.title: The role of core stability training in improving balance and poomsae technique quality in taekwondo poomsae athletes with neuromuscular control deficits with trunk involvement: a randomized controlled trial
items.summary: Core stability training significantly improved static and dynamic balance, trunk muscle endurance, and selected poomsae performance measures in taekwondo athletes, though only specific trunk endurance and balance measures showed significant between-group differences post-correction.
items.curatedReason: 这项RCT提示，核心稳定性训练可提升跆拳道品势运动员的平衡能力和躯干肌肉耐力，部分表现指标也有改善。然而，其对竞技优势和伤病预防的直接转化价值仍需进一步研究。
items.titleZh: 核心稳定性训练在改善患有躯干参与的神经肌肉控制缺陷的跆拳道品势运动员的平衡和品势技术质量中的作用：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 核心稳定性训练显著改善了跆拳道运动员的静态和动态平衡、躯干肌肉耐力以及选定的品势表现指标，但仅在校正后特定躯干耐力和平衡指标显示出显著的组间差异。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT suggests that core stability training can improve balance and trunk muscle endurance in taekwondo poomsae athletes, with some improvements in selected sport-specific performance. While promising, the direct translation to competitive advantage and injury reduction requires further investigation.
items.limitation: 本研究在伊朗进行；部分运动表现指标和受伤风险的改善不显著。
items.limitationEn: Study conducted in Iran; improvements in some performance measures and injury risk were not significant.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Low balance confidence in relation to strength training, walking, sitting, and physical function among women aged 75–105 years: a cross-sectional study within the Women’s Health Initiative Strong and Healthy (WHISH) Intervention Cohort
items.summary: In women aged 75-105, low balance confidence was associated with increased sitting time and lower physical function, while higher balance confidence was linked to more strength training and walking. The prevalence of low balance confidence was higher in those aged 85+.
items.curatedReason: 这项针对75-105岁老年女性的横断面研究发现，平衡信心不足与久坐时间增加、身体功能下降相关，而平衡信心高则与力量训练、步行活动及更好的身体功能相关。这强化了在老年人群中推广这些活动的重要性。
items.titleZh: 75-105岁女性的平衡信心低与力量训练、行走、久坐和身体功能的关系：一项女性健康倡议强健与健康（WHISH）干预队列的横断面研究
items.summaryZh: 在75-105岁的女性中，平衡信心低与久坐时间增加和身体功能下降有关，而平衡信心高则与更多的力量训练和行走有关。85岁以上女性的低平衡信心患病率更高。
items.curatedReasonEn: This cross-sectional study in older women (75-105 years) identifies strong associations between lower balance confidence and factors like sitting time, while higher confidence is linked to strength training, walking, and better physical function. This reinforces the importance of promoting these activities in geriatric populations.
items.limitation: 横断面设计限制了时间顺序的确定；研究结果需在纵向研究中得到证实。
items.limitationEn: Cross-sectional design limits the establishment of temporality; findings need confirmation in longitudinal studies.

items.title: Effects of extracorporeal shockwave therapy on pain intensity and functional disability in chronic low back pain: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of 9 RCTs (N=430) found that radial extracorporeal shockwave therapy (rESWT) significantly reduced pain in chronic low back pain (SMD = -0.72; 95% CI -1.30 to -0.14), but functional improvements (MD = -6.12) did not meet the minimal clinically important difference.
items.curatedReason: 针对慢性腰痛，体外冲击波疗法（ESWT）特别是径向冲击波（rESWT）在短期疼痛管理上显示出中等效应量（SMD = -0.72），但功能改善的临床意义不明显。别将其作为独立疗法，而应作为运动疗法的辅助手段。
items.titleZh: 体外冲击波疗法对慢性腰痛疼痛强度和功能障碍的影响：系统综述和荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项包含9项RCT（N=430）的系统综述和荟萃分析显示，径向体外冲击波疗法（rESWT）可显著减轻慢性腰痛患者的疼痛（SMD = -0.72），但功能改善（MD = -6.12）未达到临床最小重要差异。
items.curatedReasonEn: For chronic low back pain, extracorporeal shockwave therapy (ESWT), especially radial ESWT (rESWT), shows a moderate effect size (SMD = -0.72) for short-term pain reduction, but functional improvements are not clinically meaningful. Do not consider it a standalone treatment; use it as an adjunct to exercise therapy.
items.limitation: 本系统综述的证据多为干预后即时评估，随访期短，且各研究间存在显著异质性。
items.limitationEn: Evidence in this systematic review is largely based on immediate post-intervention assessments with short follow-up, and there is significant heterogeneity among studies.

items.title: Physical activity guidelines' impact on cognition in multiple sclerosis: a systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized clinical trials.
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of 12 RCTs (N=462) found that meeting physical activity guidelines for people with multiple sclerosis (MS) significantly improved processing speed (SMD = 0.29), visuospatial memory (SMD = 0.47), and verbal memory (SMD = 0.75).
items.curatedReason: 这项系统综述明确指出，达到多发性硬化症（MS）患者的身体活动指南要求，可以显著改善处理速度和记忆力。在管理MS患者时，将达标的运动处方纳入认知康复计划，这应成为你的首选干预方案。
items.titleZh: 身体活动指南对多发性硬化症患者认知功能的影响：随机临床试验的系统综述和荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项包含12项RCT（N=462）的系统综述和荟萃分析发现，达到多发性硬化症（MS）患者的身体活动指南要求，可显著改善处理速度（SMD = 0.29）、视觉空间记忆（SMD = 0.47）和言语记忆（SMD = 0.75）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review clearly indicates that meeting physical activity guidelines for people with multiple sclerosis (MS) can significantly improve processing speed and memory. When managing MS patients, incorporating guideline-compliant exercise prescriptions into cognitive rehabilitation programs should be your preferred intervention.
items.limitation: 本系统综述纳入的随机对照试验数量有限，且存在较高偏倚风险。
items.limitationEn: This systematic review included a limited number of randomized controlled trials with a high risk of bias.

items.title: Feasibility of Distributed Wearable Ultrasound for Detecting Neuromuscular Coordination Differences After Knee Injury
items.summary: A feasibility study with 20 NCAA Division I women athletes (8 with prior knee injury) using a four-channel distributed wearable ultrasound (D-WUS) system found that D-WUS detected significant differences in right-limb neuromuscular coordination (VL-VMO correlation p=0.029; timing symmetry p=0.019) in those with previous knee injuries, differences not reflected in force-plate biomechanics.
items.curatedReason: 可穿戴超声系统在检测膝关节损伤后神经肌肉协调性差异方面表现出可行性，且能发现传统力板生物力学未反映出的问题。在评估和监测膝关节康复进展时，未来可以考虑将其作为客观量化肌肉收缩模式的补充工具，但目前尚需大规模研究验证其临床实用性。
items.titleZh: 可穿戴分布式超声检测膝关节损伤后神经肌肉协调差异的可行性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项针对20名NCAA一级大学女子运动员（8名有既往膝关节损伤）的可行性研究，使用四通道分布式可穿戴超声（D-WUS）系统，发现在有既往膝关节损伤的运动员中，D-WUS能检测到右肢神经肌肉协调性的显著差异（VL-VMO相关性 p=0.029；时间对称性 p=0.019），这些差异未在力板生物力学中体现。
items.curatedReasonEn: Wearable ultrasound systems show feasibility in detecting neuromuscular coordination differences after knee injury, revealing issues not reflected by traditional force plate biomechanics. In assessing and monitoring knee rehabilitation progress, consider it a supplementary tool for objective quantification of muscle contraction patterns, though large-scale studies are needed to validate its clinical utility.
items.limitation: 本研究是初步的可行性研究，样本量小（N=20），且仅限于大学女子运动员这一特定人群。
items.limitationEn: This is a preliminary feasibility study with a small sample size (N=20) and is limited to a specific population of NCAA Division I women athletes.

items.title: Significant others' perspectives on formal supports at 3- and 12-months post-discharge from specialist rehabilitation units following acquired brain injury and spinal cord injury.
items.summary: A qualitative study exploring perspectives of 24 significant others at 3 months and 19 at 12 months post-discharge from inpatient rehabilitation found that family members play a central role in filling gaps in formal support systems for individuals with acquired brain injury and spinal cord injury, highlighting communication and support understanding as key barriers.
items.curatedReason: 本研究揭示了脑损伤和脊髓损伤患者出院后，家庭成员在正式支持服务中面临的挑战。作为临床医生，你必须主动且清晰地向家属提供支持资源信息，并更早地将他们纳入康复决策过程，以减轻家属的负担并提高患者依从性。
items.titleZh: 脑损伤和脊髓损伤患者出院后 3 个月和 12 个月主要照护者对正式支持的看法
items.summaryZh: 一项定性研究调查了24名和19名主要照护者在脑损伤和脊髓损伤患者出院后3个月和12个月的看法，发现家庭成员在弥补正式支持系统不足方面发挥核心作用，并强调沟通和对支持的理解是主要障碍。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study reveals the challenges faced by family members in accessing formal support services after discharge for patients with acquired brain injury and spinal cord injury. As a clinician, you must proactively and clearly provide families with information about support resources and involve them earlier in the rehabilitation decision-making process to alleviate caregiver burden and improve patient adherence.
items.limitation: 本研究采用定性方法，样本量相对较小，结果主要反映了特定地区（澳大利亚昆士兰州）家属的视角。
items.limitationEn: This qualitative study has a relatively small sample size, and its findings primarily reflect the perspectives of family members in a specific region (Queensland, Australia).

items.title: Process evaluation of daily electrical stimulation to prevent recurring pressure ulcers in individuals with spinal cord injury: the SCI PREVOLT trial.
items.summary: A mixed-methods process evaluation with 70 participants and 13 healthcare professionals assessed the implementation of electrical stimulation (ES) for pressure ulcer prevention in individuals with spinal cord injury, identifying limited evidence, usability issues, and organizational barriers (e.g., lack of reimbursement) that hinder adoption and adherence in home and rehabilitation settings.
items.curatedReason: 这项过程评估揭示了在家用和康复环境中实施电刺激预防脊髓损伤压疮的障碍，包括证据有限、可用性差和组织问题。在你考虑推广或应用类似技术时，务必关注这些实际障碍，确保有明确的指导和支持。
items.titleZh: 脊髓损伤患者日常电刺激预防压疮复发的过程评估：SCI PREVOLT 试验
items.summaryZh: 一项包含70名参与者和13名医疗专业人员的混合方法过程评估，旨在评估电刺激（ES）预防脊髓损伤压疮的实施情况，发现证据有限、可用性问题和组织障碍（如缺乏报销）是阻碍在家用和康复环境中采用和依从性的主要因素。
items.curatedReasonEn: This process evaluation reveals barriers to implementing electrical stimulation for pressure ulcer prevention in spinal cord injury patients at home and in rehabilitation settings, including limited evidence, poor usability, and organizational issues. When considering the adoption or promotion of similar technologies, you must address these practical barriers by ensuring clear guidance and support.
items.limitation: 本研究是一项过程评估，主要关注实施障碍，而非干预措施本身的疗效。研究结果基于混合方法，可能存在定性数据的主观性。
items.limitationEn: This study is a process evaluation focusing on implementation barriers rather than the efficacy of the intervention itself. The findings are based on mixed methods, which may involve subjectivity in qualitative data.

items.title: Transcutaneous Vagus Nerve Stimulation Improves Motor Function of Upper Extremity in Adults with Chronic Ischemic Stroke: A Randomized Controlled Trial.
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial found transcutaneous auricular vagus nerve stimulation (taVNS) combined with upper limb exercises significantly improved upper extremity motor function (FMA-UE MD = 3.95) and shoulder/elbow muscle strength in chronic ischemic stroke patients compared to sham, though FMA-UE clinical relevance needs cautious interpretation.
items.curatedReason: 经皮耳迷走神经刺激 (taVNS) 有望成为慢性缺血性卒中患者上肢功能康复的辅助手段。但请注意，FMA-UE 临床相关性需谨慎解读。
items.titleZh: 经皮迷走神经刺激改善慢性缺血性卒中成人上肢运动功能：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验发现，与假治疗相比，经皮耳迷走神经刺激（taVNS）联合上肢锻炼显著改善了慢性缺血性卒中患者的上肢运动功能（FMA-UE MD = 3.95）及肩肘肌肉力量，但 FMA-UE 的临床相关性需谨慎解读。
items.curatedReasonEn: Transcutaneous auricular vagal nerve stimulation (taVNS) shows promise as an adjunct for upper extremity motor function recovery in chronic ischemic stroke patients. However, be cautious as the FMA-UE clinical relevance needs cautious interpretation.
items.limitation: 研究样本量较小，仅限于慢性缺血性卒中，且未达到关键结局指标FMA-UE的临床最小重要差异。
items.limitationEn: The study has a small sample size, is limited to chronic ischemic stroke, and the key outcome FMA-UE did not reach the minimal clinically important difference.

items.title: Development and validation of a prediction model for subsequent fractures after hip fracture surgery in older adults: a retrospective cohort study.
items.summary: A retrospective cohort study developed and validated a nomogram to predict subsequent fractures within 2 years after hip fracture surgery in older adults, showing good discriminative performance (C-index 0.891 in development cohort) with age, hip function, neurodegenerative disease, eye disease, and living alone as predictors, and exercise as a protective factor.
items.curatedReason: 对于髋部骨折术后的老年患者，这个回顾性队列研究提示我们可以通过年龄、髋关节功能、神经退行性疾病、眼疾和独居等因素，加上运动史，初步判断两年内再骨折的风险。不过，这只是个回顾性观察研究，在临床上真正使用这个列线图前，需要更强的RCT证据验证其前瞻性预测效力。
items.titleZh: 老年髋部骨折术后再次骨折预测模型的开发与验证：一项回顾性队列研究
items.summaryZh: 一项回顾性队列研究开发并验证了一个用于预测老年髋部骨折术后两年内再次骨折的列线图。该模型表现出良好的区分度（开发队列 C-index 0.891），识别出年龄、髋关节功能、神经退行性疾病、眼疾、独居为预测因素，运动为保护因素。
items.curatedReasonEn: For older adults post-hip fracture surgery, this retrospective cohort study suggests we can use factors like age, hip function, neurodegenerative disease, eye disease, and living alone, alongside exercise history, to estimate the risk of re-fracture within two years. However, this is a retrospective observational study; stronger RCT evidence is needed to prospectively validate its predictive power before clinical implementation.
items.limitation: 这是一项回顾性队列研究，尽管进行了时间验证，但仍需要前瞻性研究来进一步确认模型的预测性能和临床实用性。
items.limitationEn: This is a retrospective cohort study; despite temporal validation, prospective studies are needed to further confirm the model's predictive performance and clinical utility.

items.title: Barriers and Facilitators Influencing Physiotherapists' Adherence to Clinical Practice Guidelines and Return to Sport Criteria after Anterior Cruciate Ligament Reconstruction: A Qualitative Study in Austria.
items.summary: A qualitative study explored barriers and facilitators influencing Austrian physiotherapists' adherence to CPGs and return to sport criteria after ACL reconstruction. Key barriers included limited guideline usability, patient expectations, resource limitations, and interprofessional misalignment, while facilitators included structured guidelines and professional development.
items.curatedReason: 你在 ACL 重建康复中推动 CPGs 依从性时，需要注意患者的期望和跨专业沟通问题，这两点可能比指南本身的设计更影响治疗师的执行。本研究提示，提升指南可用性和专业发展仍是关键。
items.titleZh: 影响物理治疗师依从 ACLR 康复临床实践指南和重返运动标准的障碍与促进因素：一项澳大利亚定性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项定性研究探讨了影响澳大利亚物理治疗师在 ACL 重建术后康复中依从临床实践指南 (CPGs) 和重返运动 (RTS) 标准的障碍和促进因素。主要障碍包括指南可用性有限、患者期望、资源限制和跨专业失调，而促进因素则包括结构化指南和专业发展。
items.curatedReasonEn: When promoting CPG adherence in ACL reconstruction rehab, patient expectations and interprofessional communication are likely more influential than guideline design itself. This study suggests that improving guideline usability and professional development remain crucial facilitators.
items.limitation: 本研究为定性研究，样本量小（9 名物理治疗师），结果主要反映受访者主观感知。
items.limitationEn: This qualitative study has a small sample size (9 physiotherapists), and its findings primarily reflect subjective perceptions.
items.journal: International journal of sports physical therapy

items.title: Effects of Single-Session High-Definition Transcranial Alternating Current Stimulation (HD-tACS) Combined with Robot-Assisted Hand Exercises on Corticospinal Excitability in Chronic Stroke.
items.summary: A preliminary randomized crossover study found that a single session of high-definition transcranial alternating current stimulation (HD-tACS) combined with robot-assisted hand exercises increased corticospinal excitability by 22.3% in chronic stroke patients, though this was not statistically significant.
items.curatedReason: 这项初步研究表明，HD-tACS 结合机器人辅助手部训练可能短期提升卒中患者的皮质脊髓兴奋性。但仍需更大样本研究验证其临床意义。
items.titleZh: 单次高清晰度经颅交流电刺激 (HD-tACS) 结合机器人辅助手部训练对慢性卒中皮质脊髓兴奋性的影响
items.summaryZh: 一项初步随机交叉研究发现，单次高清晰度经颅交流电刺激 (HD-tACS) 结合机器人辅助手部训练，使慢性卒中患者的皮质脊髓兴奋性增加了约 22.3%，但该变化未达到统计学显著性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This preliminary study suggests that HD-tACS combined with robot-assisted hand exercises may acutely enhance corticospinal excitability in stroke patients. However, larger studies are needed to confirm its clinical significance.
items.limitation: 本研究为初步小样本（7 名卒中患者）研究，缺乏长期随访数据，无法确定干预的临床疗效。
items.limitationEn: This is a preliminary small-sample study (7 stroke patients) lacking long-term follow-up data, thus unable to determine the clinical efficacy of the intervention.
items.journal: American journal of physical medicine & rehabilitation

items.title: How do neurorehabilitation patients perceive their fundamental care needs? Findings from a qualitative study.
items.summary: A qualitative study in Italy explored how neurorehabilitation patients perceive their fundamental care needs, finding that care encompasses physical, psychosocial, and relational dimensions, emphasizing dignity, respectful communication, emotional support, and empathy beyond technical tasks.
items.curatedReason: 这项定性研究强调了神经康复患者对“基本照护”的需求不仅限于身体任务，更包含社会心理和关系维度。将其纳入你的康复评估和护理计划，有助于提供更全面和以患者为中心的照护。
items.titleZh: 神经康复患者如何看待其基本照护需求？一项定性研究的发现
items.summaryZh: 一项在意大利进行的定性研究探讨了神经康复患者如何看待其基本照护需求，发现照护涵盖身体、社会心理和关系维度，强调尊严、尊重沟通、情感支持和同理心，而非仅仅技术任务。
items.curatedReasonEn: This qualitative study emphasizes that neurorehabilitation patients' 'fundamental care' needs extend beyond physical tasks to include psychosocial and relational dimensions. Incorporating these into your rehabilitation assessment and care planning can help you provide more comprehensive, person-centered care.
items.limitation: 本研究为意大利一家康复医院的定性分析，结果可能受文化背景和特定医疗环境影响。
items.limitationEn: This qualitative analysis was conducted at a rehabilitation hospital in Italy, and its findings may be influenced by cultural background and specific healthcare settings.
items.journal: PM & R : the journal of injury, function, and rehabilitation

items.title: Bothersome and activity-limiting pain in community-dwelling older adults with versus without stroke: a cross-sectional analysis of the National Health and Aging Trends study (2011-2024).
items.summary: A cross-sectional analysis of the National Health and Aging Trends Study (2011-2024) found that community-dwelling older adults with a history of stroke had a significantly higher prevalence of bothersome pain (60.77% vs 54.66%) and activity-limiting pain (62.83% vs 52.00%) compared to those without stroke.
items.curatedReason: 这项对 NHATS 数据的分析证实，社区居住的卒中老年人报告的恼人疼痛和活动受限性疼痛发生率显著更高（OR 1.30 和 1.20）。在老年卒中康复中，你应高度重视疼痛评估和管理。
items.titleZh: 社区居住老年卒中患者与非卒中老年人恼人疼痛和活动受限性疼痛的比较：一项全国健康老龄化趋势研究（2011-2024）的横断面分析
items.summaryZh: 一项对全国健康老龄化趋势研究（2011-2024）的横断面分析发现，社区居住的卒中史老年人比无卒中史老年人，恼人疼痛（60.77% vs 54.66%）和活动受限性疼痛（62.83% vs 52.00%）的患病率显著更高。
items.curatedReasonEn: This analysis of NHATS data confirms that community-dwelling older adults with stroke report a significantly higher prevalence of bothersome (OR 1.30) and activity-limiting pain (OR 1.20). You should prioritize pain assessment and management in geriatric stroke rehabilitation.
items.limitation: 本研究为横断面分析，无法建立卒中与疼痛之间的因果关系。
items.limitationEn: This is a cross-sectional analysis, which cannot establish a causal relationship between stroke and pain.
